verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Canny has a public feedback portal that can be linked to and capture feedback directly from customers (canny-docs-1, canny-docs-7, canny-docs-8), implying a hosted portal exists independent of engineering work, but there is no explicit walkthrough or claim describing a self-serve, no-code setup flow for PMs (e.g., branding, workflow config, embedding without dev involvement). Missing for 10: explicit no-code/self-serve setup documentation, PM-facing admin UI walkthrough, independent confirmation that no engineering is needed to launch the portal.
